title: Front brake pad, disc, and caliper service

requirements.display_name: Front brake caliper assembly for Civic Hybrid
Honda Heavy Duty DOT 3 brake fluid

actions.title: Confirm the front brake variant
actions.instruction: Confirm the exact 2009 Civic Hybrid front-brake configuration before opening the assembly. The Hybrid pad, disc, and caliper references are not treated as interchangeable with 1.8L or Si hardware.

actions.title: Secure, lift, and remove the front wheel
actions.instruction: Park level, chock the wheels, loosen the wheel nuts, lift at the proper point, support the vehicle safely, and remove the front wheel.
actions.warning_text: Do not rely on the hydraulic jack alone while working around the brake assembly.

actions.title: Inspect the front brake assembly
actions.instruction: Inspect pad thickness, disc surface, caliper boots, hose condition, guide-pin condition, and any evidence of brake-fluid leakage before removing service parts.

actions.title: Open the caliper and remove the pads
actions.instruction: Remove the caliper as required by the exact procedure, support it so the brake hose carries no weight, and remove the pads and associated hardware.
actions.warning_text: Avoid breathing brake dust and do not clean the brake assembly with an air hose.

actions.title: Service pad contact points and caliper movement
actions.instruction: Clean the appropriate bracket and retainer contact points, verify correct guide-pin movement, and keep grease and other contamination off the pad friction material and disc faces.

actions.title: Retract the piston and install the pads
actions.instruction: Monitor the brake-fluid reservoir while retracting the piston, then install the correct Hybrid pads, shims, and hardware. Stop if the piston does not retract normally.

actions.title: Reassemble the front brakes and wheel
actions.instruction: Reinstall the caliper and any serviced disc components using the applicable service fastener torques, then reinstall the wheel and tighten the wheel nuts to 108 N·m (80 lbf·ft).

actions.title: Restore and verify a firm brake pedal
actions.instruction: Pump the brake pedal until it is firm, verify the fluid level, inspect for leaks or interference, and perform a cautious stationary brake check before moving the vehicle.
actions.warning_text: Do not move the vehicle until a firm brake pedal is restored.
